levels.growth: per level above 1: hp +3, nerve +2, acc +1 every 2nd, eva +1 every 3rd, faith +1 every 4th, dmg +1 every 4th

tweed_travelling_coat.name: Tweed travelling coat
tweed_travelling_coat.desc: Good English wool; it turns a glancing blow.

buffalo_coat.name: Buffalo coat
buffalo_coat.desc: Prairie leather, thick as a door.

captains_oilskin.name: Captain's oilskin
captains_oilskin.desc: Stiff with salt; it has seen the Bay of Biscay.

doctors_greatcoat.name: Doctor's greatcoat
doctors_greatcoat.desc: Pockets for everything a physician needs.

lords_riding_coat.name: Lord's riding coat
lords_riding_coat.desc: Cut by a good tailor, lined against the cold.

sword_cane.name: Sword-cane
sword_cane.desc: An elegant stick with eighteen inches of steel inside.

kukri.name: Kukri
kukri.desc: A heavy curved knife from the East.

crucifix.name: Crucifix
crucifix.desc: A simple cross to hold on to.

garlic_wreath.name: Garlic wreath
garlic_wreath.desc: Worn about the neck: pungent and comforting.

demeter_voyage_keepsake.name: Captain's crucifix and rosary
demeter_voyage_keepsake.desc: Bound in a dead man's hands.

harker_road_sealed_journal.name: Sealed journal
harker_road_sealed_journal.desc: Jonathan's shorthand, under Sister Agatha's seal.

rules.running_water: cannot cross unaided except at slack or full tide (puzzle/timing rule)

list.text: A crucifix halts a vampire's attack.
Garlic repels the Un-Dead; garlic in the mouth when staked.
The Sacred Wafer (Host) holds a vampire back and sterilises its earth.
Wild rose on a coffin keeps the Un-Dead from leaving it.
A vampire cannot enter a home unless invited, of free will.
Powers wane by day; helpless in the box between sunrise and sunset.
Cannot cross running water unaided except at slack or full tide.
Must rest in boxes of his native earth; needs the earth to be unsterilised.
Staking through the heart and beheading destroys a vampire.
Commands wolves, rats, bats and moths; mist form.
Strength of many men; hypnotic gaze; blood-bond with victims.
Sacred bullet and kukri/bowie blade can wound him (final chase).

torch.name: Torch
torch.book: Fire and wood as defence, ch.18

harker.name: Jonathan Harker
harker.blurb: Solicitor. Notes everything in shorthand; survived the castle.

mina.name: Mina Harker
mina.blurb: Schoolmistress. Typewriter, timetables, and the bond that sees through the Count's eyes.

vanhelsing.name: Prof. Van Helsing
vanhelsing.blurb: Doctor, lawyer, metaphysician. Knows the rites.

seward.name: Dr. John Seward
seward.blurb: Asylum physician; chloral, morphia and the transfusion needle.

arthur.name: Arthur Holmwood
arthur.blurb: Lord Godalming. Drove the stake home for Lucy.

lucy.name: Lucy Westenra
lucy.blurb: A bright girl with three suitors and a sleeping habit.

renfield.name: R. M. Renfield
renfield.blurb: Zoophagous patient. Sees much that others do not.

dracula.name: The Voivode
dracula.blurb: Before the legend: a prince of the Carpathians.

captain.name: Captain of the Demeter
captain.blurb: A Russian master who lashed himself to the wheel.

insight.name: Insight
insight.text: Study the enemy: party hits more often for 3 turns, weaknesses shown.

brace.name: Brace
brace.text: Take a defensive stance and steady your nerve (+4).

holy_circle.name: Holy circle
holy_circle.text: Ring of Host crumbs: vampire blows are blunted by 70% and their gaze fails for 3 turns. Costs 1 Host.

sedate.name: Sedate
sedate.text: Chloral: a living enemy falls asleep for 3 turns. Costs 1 chloral.

transfuse.name: Transfuse
transfuse.text: Give blood: ally +12 HP, you lose 4 HP.

steady_shot.name: Steady shot
steady_shot.text: Aimed rifle shot, +25% accuracy, double damage. Needs a ranged weapon & ammo.

rally.name: Rally
rally.text: All allies +3 nerve and +10% accuracy for 3 turns.

stake_strike.name: Stake & hammer
stake_strike.text: Drive the stake: destroys an undead below 35% HP, or one that is helpless.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.book: Wolves of the Borgo pass, ch.1,3,27

szgany.name: Szgany rider
szgany.book: Szgany escort of the box, ch.27

a2_dog.name: The huge dog
a2_dog.book: ch.7 the immense dog that leapt from the Demeter

a3_berserker.name: Berserker
a3_berserker.book: the escaped wolf of the Zoological Gardens, ch.11

arthur_burden_lean_wolf.name: Starved wolf
arthur_burden_lean_wolf.book: the escaped wolf of the Home Wood (invented)

dracula_voivode_akinji.name: Akinji raider
dracula_voivode_akinji.book: Turkish light horse on the Danube border (Ch.3, invented)

borgo_wolves.name: Wolves at the pass
borgo_wolves.intro: The howling is close. Yellow eyes in the dark.
borgo_wolves.win: The wolves slink back into the trees.

szgany_cart.name: The Szgany cart
szgany_cart.intro: The Szgany close round the leiter-wagon with the box.

brides_wing.name: The three sisters
brides_wing.intro: 'He is young and strong; there are kisses for us all.'
brides_wing.win: They fall back, hissing, into the shadows.
brides_wing.dawn_text: A cock crows somewhere far off. The three shapes thin and vanish.

brides_tombs.name: The sisters' tombs
brides_tombs.intro: By day they lie in their tombs, lovely and still. Now is the time.
brides_tombs.win: The three sisters are at peace.

lucy_tomb.name: Lucy in the tomb
lucy_tomb.intro: She comes toward us with a wanton smile.
lucy_tomb.win: At last the poor soul is at rest.

carfax_rats.name: Rats of Carfax
carfax_rats.intro: Thousands of rats, with eyes like coals.
carfax_rats.win: The rats scatter before the lamps.

renfield_frenzy.name: Renfield
renfield_frenzy.intro: He springs, with the strength of a madman.

dracula_chase.name: The Count at sunset
dracula_chase.intro: The sun is nearly down. The lid of the box is lifted.

a2_dog_pier.name: The dog under the pier
a2_dog_pier.intro: It crouches, hackles up, in the shadow of the pier. It has been fed on something, and not dog-biscuit.
a2_dog_pier.win: The dog yelps and slinks away up the cliff, tail between its legs.

a3_berserker_night.name: The wolf in Lucy's room
a3_berserker_night.intro: The window bursts inward. A great grey wolf lands on the carpet, between us and the bed.
a3_berserker_night.win: The wolf yelps, and is gone through the glass into the dark.

a3_renfield_struggle.name: Renfield in his cell
a3_renfield_struggle.intro: Renfield flings himself at me with a madman's strength, snarling about lives and masters.
a3_renfield_struggle.win: Hennessey and I pin him until he is quiet.

a4_lucy_vigil.name: The Bloofer Lady at the tomb
a4_lucy_vigil.intro: 'Come to me, Arthur. My arms are hungry for you.' The golden crucifix is raised, but the child is still in her arms.
a4_lucy_vigil.win: She shrinks from the cross, hissing, and will not pass it.
a4_lucy_vigil.dawn_text: The first grey light touches the yews. She breaks away with a snarl and is gone toward the vault.

a5_picc_ambush.name: The Count at the door
a5_picc_ambush.intro: The door bursts. The Count is there, a hired ruffian at each shoulder and a bat at his collar. 'Stand aside!'
a5_picc_ambush.win: The hirelings fall. The Count has leapt through the gap like a cat through rats.

a6_wolf_pack.name: Wolves on the bank road
a6_wolf_pack.intro: The howling swells behind us. Yellow eyes show between the pines as the snow begins to fall.
a6_wolf_pack.win: The great wolf breaks off, and the pack melts into the dark. The horses stop trembling.

arthur_burden_poachers.name: Poachers in the Home Wood
arthur_burden_poachers.intro: A shutter drops and a lantern blazes. Two men and a starved wolf come out of the bracken. 'It's the new Lord,' one of them says, and then, to the beast, 'Get him.'
arthur_burden_poachers.win: The wolf bolts. The men cry for quarter and I give it. The tenants will hear of this by dawn.

demeter_voyage_dark_blessed.name: The dark in the hold
demeter_voyage_dark_blessed.intro: The earth in box thirteen is grey and cold. Something that has lost its bed is looking for another. A lantern swings, and the boxes shift on their lashings.
demeter_voyage_dark_blessed.win: I keep the cross between us and the dark. It does not like it.
demeter_voyage_dark_blessed.dawn_text: A grey line at the hatch. The thing among the boxes is gone, and the bat with it.

demeter_voyage_dark_burned.name: The dark in the hold
demeter_voyage_dark_burned.intro: The smoke is rolling; the earth is smouldering in box thirteen. The dark is full of wings and a tall shape that is not afraid of fire, only of me.
demeter_voyage_dark_burned.win: I hold the cross against them, while the smoke thins.
demeter_voyage_dark_burned.dawn_text: A grey line at the hatch. The wings are gone, the shape is gone, and I am alone with the burned box.

dracula_voivode_raid.name: The night raid at the Reed Ford
dracula_voivode_raid.intro: They come out of the reeds in the dark, wet and silent, with knives in their teeth. I draw my father's hammer. There are three of them and there is one of me, and I find, with some alarm, that this makes me happier than I have been in weeks.
dracula_voivode_raid.win: The last of them goes into the river and does not come up. Across the water a horn sounds the retreat. I am shaking, and the dawn is just beginning.

dracula_voivode_wolves.name: Wolves on the mountain road
dracula_voivode_wolves.intro: The wolves have followed the cart for three days. Tonight the great one steps forward and stands in the road. I am a prince, and I have been told that wolves are my people's emblem. Let us see.
dracula_voivode_wolves.win: The alpha limps off. The others look at me, once, with an expression I can only call respect.

harker_road_wolves.name: Wolves on the path
harker_road_wolves.intro: The grey shapes close from either side of the track. I have a poker, a spade and my courage, in that order.
harker_road_wolves.win: The wolves slink back into the gorse, one of them limping.

mina_records_dusk_bats.name: Bats at the Abbey
mina_records_dusk_bats.intro: Two bats wheel over the tombs and drop toward my hair. I have an umbrella, and rather more nerve than I knew.
mina_records_dusk_bats.win: The bats fall back and are gone into the Abbey ruins.

quincey_hunt_wolves.name: Wolves at the ford
quincey_hunt_wolves.intro: Two grey wolves slide out of the reeds, lips drawn back. They are thin and desperate.
quincey_hunt_wolves.win: The last wolf drops. The reeds go quiet.

quincey_hunt_rustlers.name: Dunning's gang
quincey_hunt_rustlers.intro: Dunning's hand slides from his belt. 'Take him!' Boots scrape behind me; the camp is on its feet.
quincey_hunt_rustlers.win: Dunning goes down on his knees. The camp is quiet. Only the horses snort.

quincey_hunt_bats.name: Bats at the lines
quincey_hunt_bats.intro: Three dark shapes, wings like torn umbrellas, drop out of the moon. I fire from the hip.
quincey_hunt_bats.win: The last of them veers out of the lantern-light and is gone. The silence afterward is worse than the noise.

renfield_mercy_scuffle.name: Scuffle with the night-man
renfield_mercy_scuffle.intro: The lantern swings round. 'You! Back to your bed!' Blunt's stick comes up. I am a thin man of fifty-nine with a madman's strength, and I know exactly how that story ends.
renfield_mercy_scuffle.win: He goes down against the wall, winded, and not hurt past a bruise. I step over him and I am not proud.

seward_asylum_frenzy.name: Renfield at the garden wall
seward_asylum_frenzy.intro: He springs at me from the shadow of the wall, with a madman's strength, snarling about lives and masters.
seward_asylum_frenzy.win: Hennessey and I pin him until he is quiet.

vanhelsing_lore_vigil.name: The vigil at Kirchdorf
vanhelsing_lore_vigil.intro: The snow does not crunch beneath her. She stands at the edge of the circle, smiling the smile of a girl of nineteen, and behind her in the dark a great grey wolf comes to heel like a dog. 'You are very far from home, Herr Doktor,' she says in a village dialect seventy years out of date.
vanhelsing_lore_vigil.win: She falls, and does not rise. The wolf is gone. In the snow, there is only a girl in a grey dress, and no more than nineteen.

garlic_wreath.name: Garlic wreath
garlic_wreath.text: Garlic flowers bound in a ring: a ward for a room, a window, or a throat.

torch.name: Torch
torch.text: A brand for the dark and for fire, which the Un-Dead fear.

holy_water.name: Holy water
holy_water.text: A crumb of the Host in clean water. Van Helsing will have it blessed.

holy_knife.name: Consecrated knife
holy_knife.text: A blade the Un-Dead cannot shrug off.

chloral.name: Chloral draught
chloral.text: Seward measures chloral into a glass.

wild_rose_wreath.name: Wild-rose wreath
wild_rose_wreath.text: Wild rose, woven for a lid.
wild_rose_wreath.book: wild rose on the box, ch.18

a4_host_putty.name: Host-putty
a4_host_putty.text: The Host crumbled into soft putty, rolled in a clean napkin: a seal for every crack in the vault door.
